t: The one part the Fire is not permitted to touch
a: فَيَعْرِفُونَهُمْ فِي النَّارِ بِأَثَرِ السُّجُودِ، تَأْكُلُ النَّارُ ابْنَ آدَمَ إِلاَّ أَثَرَ السُّجُودِ
p: Fa-yaʿrifūnahum fi-n-nāri bi-athari-s-sujūd. Taʾkulu-n-nāru-bna Ādama illā athara-s-sujūd
m: They will recognise them in the Fire by the mark of prostration. The Fire consumes the son of Adam except for the mark of prostration.
